tagging_state_machine.alias_rule: Any alpha passing ALL RA hard checks (0 FAIL) AND local SC < 0.65 MUST receive alias `name = 'SC 0.xxx PC 0.xxx'`.
tagging_state_machine.margin_preference: When all RA + SC + PC conditions pass, strictly prefer HIGHER margin (bp) first (both in orthogonal subset selection and final Useful ranking).
tagging_state_machine.SC_PASS: All platform hard checks PASS (0 FAIL) AND local 92-OS SC < 0.65, ONLY remote PC >= 0.70 -> apply tag `SC_PASS` + alias `SC 0.xxx PC 0.xxx` and queue for dedicated PC-crushing optimization.
tagging_state_machine.Useful: All platform hard checks PASS (0 FAIL) AND local 92-OS SC < 0.65 AND intra-pool pairwise SC < 0.68 AND remote PC < 0.70 -> apply tag `Useful` + alias `SC 0.xxx PC 0.xxx` (ranked by Margin DESC; NEVER auto-submit).
tagging_state_machine.SC_IS_HIGHT: Local or remote SC >= 0.70 -> terminal high-SC marker.
tagging_state_machine.PC_IS_HIGHT: Unrescuable high PC (>= 0.85 after PC-crushing stack) -> terminal high-PC marker.
